reviews.title: Not Happy
reviews.text: I regret purchasing the annual subscription for $99.99. The app frequently crashes while scanning receipts, though it does save your progress upon restarting. It lacks essential features like organizing receipts by month or day and does not provide totals or visual spending graphs. Additionally, there are no export options to common formats like PDF or Excel, not even email making it hard to manage finances effectively. Given its limitations, the price feels excessive; a more reasonable annual fee would be around $30. I can't recommend this app in its current state. Skip do not download until features are added.
